card.name: Start of split drug and medical words
card.fires_on: The first piece of a long drug or medical word that is broken up, where the rest of the word follows. It is often an S inside an all-caps drug name such as DICLOFENAC SODIUM, or a start like immun or hemorrh.

modes.label: S in capitalized drug names
modes.description: The letter S that begins SODIUM or Syrup after a capitalized drug name or parenthesis.

modes.label: Start of long medical terms
modes.description: The opening piece of a long clinical word such as immunosuppressive or hemorrhagic.

card.writes: It seems to push the next piece toward the middle of a word (like a sound or body-part piece) and away from the word normalized.
card.plain: It fires when a long drug or medical word has just started and the rest of the word is still to come.
